route.name: 上城 · 驾驶与飞越
rules: Start stopped on the existing 8 m terrace road, heading +Z; starting never teleports or refills.
Drive on wheels at least 18 m and cross z=252 before taking off inside the marked strip.
Cross the gate once in +Z while fully airborne; the physical hull/tyre envelope must fit the 11 by 5.4 m opening.
Touch down only inside the marked terrace area, with <=1.4 m/s descent and <=8 degree tilt; no hull collision.
At least 3 wheels on upper-city-terrace, slow translation and rotation for 0.5 s are required before completion.
Reset, refill, changed wind/fault/model parameters or a discontinuity end the attempt; cancel releases the observer without moving the vehicle.
route.scope: A single curated route on an existing vehicle platform. It does not certify other roads, rooftop access, arbitrary jumps or finite-gas success.

gateCrossing.method: linear 120 Hz endpoint envelope projection at CG plane crossing; not a continuous curved swept-volume certificate

summary.clearanceMeaning: Minimum world-Y corner gap of the four actual hull boxes above the declared flat 8 m terrace; an estimate, not city AGL or recovery height.
summary.supplyMeaning: External regulated flow; not an onboard tank consumption result.
